verdict.rationale: OpenCode is itself an AI coding agent. It documents delegating work to primary agents, a read-only plan/explore agent, @-mentionable subagents, parallel multi-session agents, `opencode run`, and GitHub `/opencode` task delegation that opens PRs. Hands-on users corroborate that subagents and the harness work well. Missing for 10: consistent reliability evidence, since community reports cite agents getting stuck in long or nested sessions and failed tool calls or file edits with local models.
